entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/checkoutservice
entities.reasoning: The checkoutservice pods entered CrashLoopBackOff, causing the service to be unavailable.
entities.evidence: Alert "KubePodCrashLoopBackOff" fired for checkoutservice pods from 2023-07-11T14:02:00Z to 2023-07-11T14:45:00Z; pod event logs show repeated container restarts.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend received 5xx responses because it could not reach checkoutservice.
entities.evidence: Alert "KubeServiceUnavailable" for frontend triggered at 2023-07-11T14:05:00Z; trace spans show timeout errors when calling checkoutservice.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend deployment pods remained running but were impacted by downstream checkout failures.
entities.evidence: No crash or restart events for frontend pods; only increased latency metrics observed.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkoutservice
entities.reasoning: Service object mirrors the failing deployment; its endpoints became empty, propagating failure.
entities.evidence: Kubernetes Endpoints object for checkoutservice empty during incident period.

propagations.condition: Pods crash and stop providing ready endpoints
propagations.effect: Service has no ready endpoints, causing DNS resolution failures

propagations.condition: Frontend calls checkoutservice via service DNS
propagations.effect: Calls time out, frontend returns HTTP 500 to users

propagations.condition: Frontend pods receive high error rate from upstream
propagations.effect: Increased latency and 5xx metrics observed on frontend pods

alerts_explained.explanation: Pods of checkoutservice repeatedly failed to start, entering CrashLoopBackOff.
Frontend service returned 5xx errors because its downstream checkoutservice had no ready endpoints.
